significance: A Rama temple in Buchireddipalem town of SPSR Nellore district, begun in 1765 by the landholder Dodla Rami Reddy and finished nineteen years later. Subsidiary shrines house Lakshmi, Lakshmi Narasimha, Andal and Hanuman.
story: Rama is said to have appeared to Dodla Rami Reddy in a dream and told him to raise the temple at Buchireddipalem.
